newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian central bank raises one/two-week rates.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian central bank raises one/two-week rates.

text.p: Indonesian central bank, Bank Indonesia, on Friday raised its interest rates for one- and two-week short-term bilateral papers (SBIs), dealers said.
One dealer said the central bank raised the rate for one-week papers to 10.0 percent from eight percent on Thursday and for two-week papers to 10.5 percent from 8.5 percent.
He said the bank kept other rates unchanged.

The bank offered one-to-three-day SBIs at 14.0 percent, four-to-six day at 12.0 percent, one-week at 10.0 percent, two-week at 10.5 percent, one-month at 10.5, three at 11.0, six at 11.625 and one-year at 12.25 percent.
